name: Sueli Carneiro
shortBio: Brazilian philosopher and founder of Geledés who adapted Foucault's biopower to formulate the "dispositivo de racialidade" and theorized epistemicide—the systematic destruction of Black and non-Western knowledge systems.
centralQuestion: How does the raciality apparatus (dispositivo de racialidade) enact epistemicide by disqualifying Black subjects as knowers while subordinating their bodily labor?

keyWorks.title: Dispositivo de racialidade: A construção do outro como não ser como fundamento do ser
keyWorks.description: Doctoral philosophy thesis synthesizing Foucauldian biopolitics and Charles Mills's Racial Contract to conceptualize raciality and epistemicide in Brazil.

keyWorks.title: Blackening Feminism (Enegrecer o feminismo)
keyWorks.description: Argues that Eurocentric Latin American feminism must be fundamentally transformed by Afro-Brazilian women's historical struggles.
